new_theorem.name: QFORM-TWO-MACRO-MINORITY-BARRIER-v1
new_theorem.statement: For Q_q=G1^2/12+G2^2/12-[sqrt((1-q)/12)N+sqrt(q/2)(U1+U2)]^2, 0<=q<=1, the output density is globally maximized at zero and ||p_q||_inf=12/sqrt(2-q) integral_0^1 (1-s) exp[-3q s^2/(2-q)] ds <=3sqrt(2), strictly for q>0.
new_theorem.fragmentation_extension: For k equal collinear minority macro rows, the leading relative loss is 3q^2/(80k).
